source: SharpWR editor, 2026-10-05. Shown in the app as the champion's core item, beside the engine's damage ranking.

Ashe.reason: Ashe has no mobility skill: Stormrazor's movement speed lets her dodge skillshots and escape. Yun Tal is also a good core.

Caitlyn.reason: Caitlyn has no mobility: Stormrazor's movement speed is a big plus.

Draven.reason: Catching an axe resets W, so Draven triggers Essence Reaver again and again. The Collector (executes) or Bloodthirster (sustain against poke) are the alternatives.

Jhin.reason: Dark Harvest, the missing-health fourth shot and the Collector's execute together finish targets that would otherwise survive.

Kog'Maw.reason: Kog'Maw plays around W: he fights while W is active, so his build is built around that skill.

Lucian.reason: Lucian's mobility stacks Stormrazor very fast. Essence Reaver is the alternative: his short cooldowns proc it often.

Samira.reason: Samira's burst has to one-shot, and with her ultimate every enemy that drops to 5% is executed.

Senna.reason: Senna now pokes from long range with big single hits and repositions; with no dash, Stormrazor's movement speed is a big plus.

Twitch.reason: After stacking poison and popping E, the Collector executes targets at around 5%.

Yunara.reason: Yun Tal first (Stormrazor can replace it), then Infinity Edge and Lord Dominik's Regards in almost every build: Yunara needs crit.

Zeri.reason: Zeri's Q is an ability with a very short cooldown, so she triggers Essence Reaver constantly.

Ezreal.reason: Long Q and ultimate range with constant ability spam: Muramana with Trinity Force, then Serylda's Grudge and Blade of the Ruined King.

Jinx.reason: Yun Tal first and Runaan's Hurricane second. Stormrazor is an option when there is no peel and the enemy has assassins.

Kai'Sa.reason: Guinsoo's Rageblade for the on-hit build; an AP build will be compared once AP items are in the database.

Sivir.reason: Yun Tal is the core; Stormrazor is a utility option with a tank but no peeling support.

Smolder.reason: Smolder plays by spamming abilities and rarely auto attacks, so Muramana for now; AP items will be compared once they are in the database.

Vayne.reason: Guinsoo's Rageblade for the on-hit build; a crit build (likely Essence Reaver, with Q's short cooldown) is compared as a separate style.

Xayah.reason: Yun Tal is a good core; a Conqueror + Essence Reaver first build is being compared for burst.
